posts.text: The Massie amendment would eliminate the Foreign Military Financing (FMF) for Israel contained in the State Department appropriations bill. It does not affect funding for missile defense programs such as Iron Dome, which are funded through the Defense appropriations bill. I believe both should be ended, but the Massie vote is only about the State Department military aid.
